text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Thursday it initiated coverage, with a neutral rating, on Spine-Tech Inc, which provides spinal implant technology including its BAK/L device.
-- Rodman & Renshaw said its revenue and earnings projections are at the low end of Wall Street expectations, because surgeons are converting to BAK/L more slowly than anticipated.
-- "(We) believe the ramp-up may occur more gradually than anticipated and result in slower revenue growth than currently forecasted," Rodman & Renshaw said in a statement.
-- The firm estimated a fourth quarter loss of $0.04 a share versus a profit of $0.02 the previous year. It said the consensus estimate is a loss of $0.01 a share.
-- Rodman & Renshaw said given its outlook for slower-than-anticipated growth, the stock's current valuation may be unwarranted and could come under pressure if Street estimates were cut.
